verdict.rationale: New Relic's own documentation shows several in-product AI features. New Relic AI lets you ask questions and troubleshoot telemetry in plain language, and it helps fix queries. Workload AI insights give AI-generated summaries of health, performance trends and potential issues. AI also flags friction points in session replays, and the vulnerability agent drafts remediation recommendations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and deeper documentation of how proactive suggestions are generated and acted on.
